tools.name: search_concours
tools.description: Search Moroccan public-sector recruitment exams (concours) with the website's own filters. Open exams only unless include_closed is true. Returns grade, employer, posts, deadline, salary, the Wadifa Info page url and the official notice url. Use list_filters for exact diploma and region values.

tools.name: get_concours
tools.description: Full details of one recruitment exam by id: dates, posts, diplomas, how to apply, official documents, past exam papers for the same grade and similar open exams.

tools.name: search_exam_papers
tools.description: Search the library of past Moroccan public recruitment exam papers (sujets / نماذج مباريات), many with a correction.

tools.name: get_exam_paper
tools.description: One past exam paper by id: description, page images, PDF and the editorial correction when there is one.

tools.name: civil_service_salaries
tools.description: Indicative net monthly pay (MAD) at the first step of about 370 Moroccan civil-service grades (official simulator basis), with a link to the salary page of each grade.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Moroccan public holidays for this year and next. Islamic holidays carry approximate=true until the Ministry of Habous confirms the moon sighting.

tools.name: school_holidays
tools.description: School breaks of the current Moroccan school year (ministerial decision), end dates inclusive.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The exact diploma and region values accepted by search_concours, with French and Arabic labels.
